rubric: Freeze source, data, seeds, backend and the declared experimental question before execution
Log traceable post-update observations to CSV and verify optional tracker histories
Retain every planned run and failed attempt; reject incomplete or incompatible comparisons
Explain paired seed differences and descriptive variability without claiming a confidence interval
Generate a research notebook with linked configurations, environments, metrics, artifacts and a learner-written decision
setupNote: Install this project’s minimal requirements.txt in an isolated Python environment. Work through four stages using the supplied Flax NNX model and CLI. CSV needs no account; TensorBoard, offline W&B and SQLite MLflow are optional implemented adapters. The generated research notebook is Markdown. GPU/TPU and multi-host measurements require separate target execution.
